title.zh: 【VanEck 推出多资产 ETF「WBMO」，涵盖股票、债券及比特币敞口】
title.en: 【VanEck 推出多资产 ETF「WBMO」，涵盖股票、债券及比特币敞口】

current_state.zh: VanEck launched the actively managed VanEck Wealth Builder ETF (WBMO) on the NYSE, combining global equities, bonds, real assets and a modest bitcoin allocation through digital asset ETPs at a 0.33% expense ratio.
current_state.en: VanEck launched the actively managed VanEck Wealth Builder ETF (WBMO) on the NYSE, combining global equities, bonds, real assets and a modest bitcoin allocation through digital asset ETPs at a 0.33% expense ratio.
